speaker: Doctor
text: Given the classic trigger of micturition and the normal ECG, this sounds like a reflex syncope, but I need to rule out cardiac structural issues. speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal ECG and echocardiogram, along with the classic presentation of syncope immediately following urination with a rapid recovery, this is highly suggestive of micturition syncope.
